cnTitle: 紫微斗数六吉星总览：你的助力是真帮忙还是看着热闹
enTitle: The Six Auspicious Assistant Stars in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Real Help or Just Noise
enDesc: The six auspicious assistants form three pairs—Zuo Fu/You Bi for team support, Wenchang/Wenqu for talent and documents, Tian Kui/Tian Yue for helpful people. Read them by whether the major star can receive them, not by their lucky name.
cnDesc: 六吉星分三组：左辅右弼给团队助力、文昌文曲给才艺文书、天魁天钺给贵人机缘，读它们要看主星能不能承接，而不是见吉就说好。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数左辅右弼区别：明面帮忙和背后补位不是一回事
enTitle: Zuo Fu vs You Bi in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Open Help and Backstage Cover Are Not the Same
enDesc: Zuo Fu is yang—visible, open help and team support; You Bi is yin—quiet backstage coordination. Together the support is complete; one alone usually reaches only halfway.
cnDesc: 左辅为阳、是看得见的公开协助与团队拥护，右弼为阴、是不张扬的暗中协调与补位，两星同会助力才完整，单见往往只到一半。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数文昌文曲区别：文书考试和口才才艺是两条路
enTitle: Wenchang vs Wenqu in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Exams-Documents and Eloquence-Talent Are Two Paths
enDesc: Wenchang leans to formal documents, exams, credentials and structure; Wenqu to eloquence, inspiration, art and emotional expression. Both signal intelligence, but one runs on system and the other on talent.
cnDesc: 文昌偏正统文书、考试、证书与条理，文曲偏口才、灵感、艺术与感性表达，两星都主聪明，但一个走体系一个走才情，别混为一谈。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天魁天钺：贵人到底从哪来、什么时候出现
enTitle: Tian Kui and Tian Yue in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Where Helpful People Come From and When They Appear
enDesc: Tian Kui and Tian Yue are the noble-helper stars, usually bringing support from seniors, bosses, institutions and key moments. Kui is open and direct, Yue indirect and timely; their palace and cycle show where the helper is.
cnDesc: 天魁天钺是贵人才德之星，多主长辈、上司、制度与关键场合的提携，天魁偏阳贵、显性直接，天钺偏阴贵、迂回及时，要看落宫和运限才知道贵人在哪。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数四煞总论：擎羊陀罗火星铃星的压力节奏完全不同
enTitle: The Four Malefics in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Yang, Tuo, Huo and Ling Stress You in Different Rhythms
enDesc: Yang is an open, fast clash; Tuo a slow, nagging drain; Huo a sudden burst; Ling a smolder that later erupts. Naming the pressure tells you whether to cut quickly or endure.
cnDesc: 擎羊是明枪、快速直接的冲突，陀罗是暗磨、拖延纠缠的消耗，火星是突发爆冲，铃星是闷烧后爆发，分清压力类型，才知道该快断还是该耐住。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数地空地劫：空耗和破耗怎么分、怎么守
enTitle: Di Kong and Di Jie in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Telling Empty Drain from Sudden Loss—and How to Guard
enDesc: Di Kong is mental empty-drain—much thought, little landing, detachment; Di Jie is material sudden loss and resource leakage. One leaks in ideas, the other in things, so the guards differ.
cnDesc: 地空主精神层面的空耗、想得多落得少与抽离感，地劫主物质层面的突发破耗与资源流失，一个漏在想法一个漏在东西，守法也不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数煞星一定不好吗：压力怎么被转成稀缺能力
enTitle: Are Malefics Always Bad in Zi Wei Dou Shu? Turning Pressure Into Scarce Ability
enDesc: Malefics are accelerators, not verdicts. When the major star can bear them and auspicious stars check them, Yang becomes decisiveness, Tuo endurance, Huo/Ling execution and burst—read the conditions for conversion, not the fear.
cnDesc: 煞星是加速器不是判决书，主星接得住、有吉星制化时，擎羊转决断、陀罗转耐力、火铃转执行与爆发，关键看转化条件而不是见煞就怕。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数贵人运怎么看：天魁天钺要和迁移官禄连起来读
enTitle: How to Read Benefactor Luck in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Connect Kui/Yue With Travel and Career
enDesc: Benefactor luck is more than Kui/Yue in the Life Palace; it matters whether they sit in Travel or Career, whether a decade activates them, and whether you stand where a patron can see you.
cnDesc: 贵人运不只看命宫有没有魁钺，更要看它们落在迁移还是官禄、有没有被大限引动，以及你本人是否走到了贵人能看见你的位置。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命宫到底看什么：它是整张盘的太极点不是全部
enTitle: What the Life Palace Really Shows in Zi Wei Dou Shu: It Is the Anchor, Not the Whole Chart
enDesc: The Life Palace is the chart's anchor—core personality, innate main line and default style. Any concrete matter still belongs to its own palace: Life sets direction, other palaces set detail.
cnDesc: 命宫是整张盘的太极点，主一个人的核心性格、天赋主轴和行事基调，但任何一件具体的事都要落到对应宫位，命宫定方向、他宫定细节。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数财帛宫看的是赚钱方式，不是你有多少存款
enTitle: The Wealth Palace Shows How You Earn, Not How Much You Have Saved
enDesc: Wealth governs cash flow, earning style and feel for money. Its major star shows whether you fit a steady salary, professional skill, business or investment; total savings also need Property and Happiness palaces.
cnDesc: 财帛宫主现金流量、赚钱方式和对钱的手感，主星决定你适合稳定薪资、专业技能、经营生意还是投资理财，存款总额还要合参田宅与福德。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数官禄宫看事业格局：怎么找到真正适合的行业
enTitle: The Career Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Reading Your Vocation and the Right Industry
enDesc: The Career Palace governs direction, work mode, the relationship with bosses and academic achievement. Its stars show whether you fit management, technical expertise, pioneering sales or a stable institution—read it before choosing an industry.
cnDesc: 官禄宫（事业宫）主事业方向、工作模式、与上司的关系和学业成就，主星组合决定你适合管理、专业技术、业务开创还是稳定体制，选行业先读它。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数迁移宫：在外发展、贵人机遇和晚年运势都藏在这
enTitle: The Travel Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Outward Growth, Opportunity and Later Years
enDesc: Travel governs going out, relocation, first impressions and fortunes away from home, and later-life state. With good stars one thrives on movement and meets helpers outside; weak or afflicted, travel brings friction.
cnDesc: 迁移宫主外出、异地、人际第一印象与在外际遇，也兼看晚年状态，主星好的人越动越旺、在外得贵人，主星弱或逢煞则出外多波折。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数福德宫：你有没有享受生活的能力，钱都未必说了算
enTitle: The Happiness Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Your Capacity to Enjoy Life, Beyond Money
enDesc: Happiness governs inner world, mental satisfaction, the capacity to enjoy and subconscious preference, and shapes spending/keeping mindset. It decides whether, after gaining things, you can actually enjoy them instead of constant anxiety.
cnDesc: 福德宫主精神世界、内心满足、享受能力与潜意识偏好，也影响花钱守钱的心态，它决定你拥有之后能不能安心享受，而不是一直焦虑。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数田宅宫：不只是买房，它管的是你的家运和资产沉淀
enTitle: The Property Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Beyond Housing, It Holds Household Fortune and Accumulated Assets
enDesc: Property governs real estate, living environment, family atmosphere and fixed-asset accumulation, plus household stores and belonging. Steady stars ease home-buying and wealth retention; afflicted or emptied, housing is unstable and assets struggle to gather.
cnDesc: 田宅宫主房产、居住环境、家庭氛围与固定资产沉淀，也看一家的库藏和归属感，主星稳则容易置业守财，逢煞忌化空则居家多变、资产难聚。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数正桃花和烂桃花怎么分：红鸾天喜与天姚咸池的分野
enTitle: True Romance vs Fleeting Attraction in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Hong Luan/Tian Xi Versus Tian Yao/Xian Chi
enDesc: Hong Luan and Tian Xi are upright-romance stars of marriage and committed bonds; Tian Yao and Xian Chi are side-romance stars of desire, ambiguity and brief attraction. Separate the nature first, then palace and cycle, or fleeting chemistry is mistaken for the one.
cnDesc: 红鸾天喜是正缘桃花，主婚嫁喜庆与关系定下来；天姚咸池是偏桃花，主情欲暧昧与短暂吸引，先分桃花性质，再看落宫和运限，才不会把露水情缘当真命。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数红鸾天喜怎么看：婚喜时机到底怎么定
enTitle: How to Read Hong Luan and Tian Xi in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Pinpointing Marriage Timing
enDesc: Hong Luan and Tian Xi are set by the birth-year branch and always face each other, governing marriage and joy. Timing needs three layers: the natal Spouse Palace for the base, the decade for the stage, and a yearly Hong Luan/Tian Xi entering a key palace as the trigger.
cnDesc: 红鸾天喜由生年地支取、永远对宫相照，主婚喜庆贺；判断结婚时机要本命夫妻宫定底子、大限定阶段、流年红鸾天喜入关键宫定触发，三层叠起来才准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数正缘怎么判断：正缘星系、结婚大限和流年桃花三步
enTitle: How to Identify a Destined Partner in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Bond Galaxy, Marriage Decade and Yearly Romance in Three Steps
enDesc: Identifying a destined partner first reads the natal Spouse star for the ideal type and relating mode, then finds which decade carries marriage conditions, and finally uses yearly romance and transformations to confirm meeting and commitment—a three-layer narrowing, not a feeling.
cnDesc: 判断正缘先看本命夫妻宫主星定理想型与相处模式，再看哪一步大限走到结婚运，最后用流年桃花与四化确认相遇定情的应期，是一套三层收窄而不是凭感觉。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天姚咸池：暧昧情缘为什么总是留不住
enTitle: Tian Yao and Xian Chi in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Ambiguous Romances Never Last
enDesc: Tian Yao governs charm, allure and ambiguous attraction; Xian Chi physical desire and brief bonds. They bring intense chemistry rather than stability; in Spouse or Happiness with malefics/Ji, they especially loop into fast-start, fast-end cycles.
cnDesc: 天姚主魅力、风情与暧昧吸引，咸池主色欲与短暂情缘，两星带来的是强烈的化学反应而非稳定关系，落夫妻或福德又逢煞忌时，尤其容易陷入开始很快、结束也快的循环。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数两个人合不合：别看星座配对，按这几步看
enTitle: Are You Two Compatible in Zi Wei Dou Shu? Skip Star Sign Matching and Follow These Steps
enDesc: Synastry is not which star pairs with which. It is whether each person's Spouse star echoes the other's Life star, whether relating modes complement, and whether birth-year Hua Ji clash—three steps and compatibility becomes clear.
cnDesc: 合盘重点不是「什么星配什么星」，而是各自夫妻宫主星是否呼应对方命宫、两人相处模式是否互补、生年化忌有没有相互冲克，三步查完合不合就有底。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数合盘飞化：把对方生年干四化飞进你盘怎么读
enTitle: Synastry Flying Transformations in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Flying Their Birth-Year Si Hua Into Your Chart
enDesc: Advanced synastry flies the other person's birth-year Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji into your twelve palaces: Lu/Quan/Ke in Life/Wealth/Career means their energy helps you; Ji in a key palace means drag or a lesson. The landing palace shows what the relationship brings you.
cnDesc: 进阶合盘把对方生年天干的禄权科忌飞进你的十二宫：禄权科入命财官是对方能量在帮你，化忌入关键宫则是拖累或课题，落宫决定这段关系给你带来什么。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数共盘和颠倒盘：价值观天然相近的组合长什么样
enTitle: Shared and Mirrored Charts in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Combinations With Naturally Aligned Values
enDesc: A shared chart means two people's star combinations closely match with aligned values; a mirrored chart means Life and key palaces reflect each other with complementary roles. Both signal natural rapport, but malefics/Ji still decide whether rapport reaches daily life.
cnDesc: 共盘指两人主星组合高度一致、价值观相近，颠倒盘指命宫与关键宫位镜像对应、角色互补，两种结构都代表天然的默契，但仍要查煞忌才知道默契能不能落到日常。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数宫干飞化入门：宫和宫之间是怎么被串联起来的
enTitle: Palace-Stem Flying Transformations for Beginners: How Palaces Connect in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: Every palace carries its own stem and can fly Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji to other palaces—palace-stem flying. It traces how a matter flows from one life domain to another, the core tool of the Flying-Star school for reading causal chains.
cnDesc: 每个宫都有自己的天干，宫干能飞出禄权科忌到别的宫，这叫宫干飞化；它用来追踪一件事从一个领域流向另一个领域的路径，是飞星派看因果串联的核心工具。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化是什么：能量从自己出发又回到自己
enTitle: What Is Self-Transformation in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Energy That Leaves and Returns to Itself
enDesc: When a palace's stem transforms a star that sits back inside that same palace, it is self-transformation. Energy cycles internally rather than flowing out, reflecting the person's inner response pattern in that domain rather than anything the environment imposes.
cnDesc: 当某宫天干化出的四化恰好落回本宫内的星，就叫自化；它代表该领域的能量在内部循环、不往外流，反映命主在这件事上的内在反应模式，而不是外部环境给的。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化禄自化忌：为什么会「得而复失、留不住」
enTitle: Self-Lu and Self-Ji in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Gains Slip Away
enDesc: Self-transformation keeps energy from flowing out and digests it inside the palace, so self-Lu often means gaining then willingly letting go—easy come, easy go—while self-Ji means losing after repeated brooding. The fix is building external anchors to retain results.
cnDesc: 自化的共同特点是能量不往外走、在本宫消化，所以自化禄常表现为得到却甘心放手、来得容易去得快，自化忌则是反复纠结后仍失去，关键在建立外部锚点把成果留住。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数生年四化、宫干飞化、自化三层怎么分、先看哪层
enTitle: Birth-Year, Flying and Self Si Hua in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Three Layers and Reading Order
enDesc: Birth-year Si Hua is fixed lifelong ground; palace flying is dynamic exchange between palaces; self-transformation is internal cycling. They divide labor: use birth-year for the body first, flying/self for function, then layer decade and year for timing.
cnDesc: 生年四化是先天底色、一生不变，宫干飞化是宫位间的动态往来，自化是某宫内部循环，三层分工不同；读盘顺序是先用生年定体，再用飞化自化看用，最后叠大限流年看时间。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数太阳坐命：发光发热的人，也要防被耗尽
enTitle: Tai Yang in the Life Palace: The One Who Shines Must Also Avoid Burning Out
enDesc: Tai Yang governs generosity, giving, reputation and the public stage. Bright, it is warm and responsible, favoring public service and outward careers; dimmed (a setting sun), it toils unseen. The key is letting light return to yourself and setting boundaries.
cnDesc: 太阳主博爱、付出、名声与公开舞台，庙旺时热心有担当、利公职与对外事业，落陷（如日落西山）则辛劳多、付出不被看见，关键是学会让光照回自己、设好边界。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数太阴坐命：温柔细腻是天赋，情绪内耗是功课
enTitle: Tai Yin in the Life Palace: Gentleness Is a Gift, Emotional Overthinking Is the Lesson
enDesc: Tai Yin is the moon—soft, meticulous, the treasury and inner feeling. Bright, it is gentle yet resilient, good with money and home; dimmed, it overthinks and drains emotionally. The key is giving sensitivity an outlet and turning feeling into craft and security.
cnDesc: 太阴主月亮、阴柔、细腻、财库与内在感受，庙旺时温柔有韧性、善理财顾家，落陷则多思敏感、易情绪内耗，关键是给细腻找出口、把感受转化成作品和安全感。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数武曲坐命：财星的实干能力和刚硬短板
enTitle: Wu Qu in the Life Palace: The Wealth Star's Grit and Its Hard Edge
enDesc: Wu Qu is the true wealth star of yin metal—execution, money sense and decisiveness. Bright with Lu/Quan it is a general who gets things done and manages money; its weak edge is hardness and isolation under malefics. Use toughness on tasks, softness on relationships.
cnDesc: 武曲为正财星、属阴金，主实干、执行力、理财与决断，庙旺化禄权时是能把事做成、把钱管住的将才，短板是刚硬寡言、逢煞易孤克，关键是把硬度用在事上、把柔软留给关系。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天相坐命：印星的协调天赋，和老好人的选择困难
enTitle: Tian Xiang in the Life Palace: The Seal Star's Coordination Gift and the People-Pleaser's Indecision
enDesc: Tian Xiang is the seal star of yang water—coordination, support, propriety and a sense of rules, skilled at balancing parties and suited to management and service-support roles. Its weak edge is over-caring about opinion, indecision and avoidance under pressure; the key is building your own judgment axis.
cnDesc: 天相为印星、属阳水，主协调、辅佐、体面与规则感，善平衡各方、适合管理与服务支持类角色，短板是过度在意他人评价、选择困难、遇压回避，关键是建立自己的判断主轴。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天同坐命：福星的随和，和躲在舒适区的陷阱
enTitle: Tian Tong in the Life Palace: The Blessing Star's Easiness and the Comfort-Zone Trap
enDesc: Tian Tong is the blessing star of yang water—gentleness, enjoyment, childlike heart and emotional value. Well supported it is lucky and self-healing with good rapport; its weak edge is comfort-seeking, avoidance and low resilience. The key is adding execution without losing ease.
cnDesc: 天同为福星、属阳水，主温和、享受、童心与情绪价值，人缘好、抗压强时是有福且能自愈的人，短板是贪图安逸、逃避压力、韧性不足，关键是在不丢掉松弛感的前提下补执行力。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数巨门坐命：口舌星的口才天赋，和是非暗耗的短板
enTitle: Ju Men in the Life Palace: The Mouth Star's Eloquence and Its Friction-and-Doubt Weak Edge
enDesc: Ju Men is the dark star of yin water (with metal), governing speech, critical thought, research and expression. Bright with Quan/Lu it lives on eloquence and expert analysis; its weak edge is suspicion, nitpicking and loose-tongued trouble. Use the mouth for expert expression, not argument.
cnDesc: 巨门为暗星、属阴水（又带金），主口舌、思辨、研究与表达，庙旺化权禄时是靠口才、专业分析吃饭的人，短板是多疑、挑剔、言多必失，关键是把「嘴」用在专业表达而非争辩是非。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数破军坐命：先锋星的破旧立新，和先破后立的代价
enTitle: Po Jun in the Life Palace: The Vanguard Star's Destroy-and-Rebuild and Its Cost
enDesc: Po Jun is the consuming star of yin water (transforming to depletion), governing pioneering, change, tearing down and rebuilding and spending. Bold and suited to opening new ground, its weak edge is high volatility, over-demolishing and poor consolidation; the key is rebuilding within the break and keeping a fallback.
cnDesc: 破军为耗星、属阴水（化气为耗），主开创、变革、推倒重来与消费，敢闯敢变、适合开拓新局，短板是波动大、易推倒过头、难守成，关键是学会「破中有立」、为变动留好后手。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限、小限、流年到底什么区别：一张表讲清
enTitle: Decade, Minor Limit and Yearly Fortune in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Clear Breakdown
enDesc: The decade governs a ten-year stage, arranged forward or backward from Life; the yearly fortune covers a calendar year with the same branch for everyone; the minor limit follows nominal age as a second yearly reference. Modern reading treats the decade as background and the year as trigger, with the minor limit as backup.
cnDesc: 大限管十年阶段运势、按命宫顺逆排，流年管一个公历年、所有人同年地支相同，小限按虚岁排、是另一套年度参考；现代看流年以大限为背景、流年为触发，小限多作辅助。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流月流日怎么排：什么时候才需要细看到月和日
enTitle: Monthly and Daily Fortune in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How to Derive Them and When You Actually Need Them
enDesc: Monthly fortune starts the first lunar month at the yearly Dou-Jun palace and proceeds in order; daily fortune starts day one at the monthly palace. They govern short-term fluctuations and are needed only for timing precise decisions—signings, interviews, trips; otherwise decade and year suffice.
cnDesc: 流月以流年斗君宫起正月顺排，流日以流月宫起初一顺排，主月度日度的短期起伏；只有在大事择期、签约、面试、出行等精确到月日的决策时才需要细看，平时看大限流年足够。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限从哪起、顺行逆行怎么定：十年一步不迷路
enTitle: Where the Decade Starts and How Its Direction Is Set in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: The decade starts its first step at the Life Palace and moves one palace every ten years; direction is set by birth-year yin/yang plus gender—yang male and yin female go forward, yin male and yang female backward—while the starting age comes from the Life Palace's five-element phase. Master start, direction and age to map life stages correctly.
cnDesc: 大限从命宫起第一步、每十年移一宫，方向由生年阴阳与性别共同决定：阳男阴女顺行、阴男阳女逆行，起运岁数由命宫五行局定，搞懂起点方向岁数，才排得对人生阶段。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数斗君：流年的总开关到底怎么找
enTitle: Dou-Jun in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Finding the Master Switch of the Yearly Chart
enDesc: Dou-Jun is the first-month origin and overall commander of the yearly chart, derived from birth month and the year branch; yearly palaces and months unfold from it. Finding Dou-Jun gives the master key to the year's rhythm and to arranging months.
cnDesc: 斗君是流年盘的正月起点与全年总领，由生月和流年地支推算，流年各宫与流月都从它展开；找到斗君，就拿到了读懂这一年节奏、再往下排流月的总钥匙。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数疾厄宫看健康：体质倾向和薄弱部位怎么读
enTitle: The Health Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Reading Constitution and Vulnerable Systems
enDesc: The Health Palace governs innate constitution, vulnerable body systems and illness patterns; star elements map to systems, and clustered malefics/Ji flag higher risk. It gives tendencies to watch long-term, not a diagnosis, and never replaces checkups or medical care.
cnDesc: 疾厄宫主先天体质、易薄弱的身体系统与生病模式，主星五行对应不同系统、煞忌聚则提示风险偏高；它给的是需要长期留意的倾向，不是诊断，更不能替代体检和就医。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数父母宫：不只是父母，还藏着长辈、文书和你的庇荫
enTitle: The Parents Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Beyond Parents—Seniors, Documents and Protection
enDesc: The Parents Palace (also appearance palace) governs bonds with parents and elders, the degree of elder protection, and also academic credentials, documents, inherited looks and relations with superiors. Auspicious transformations bring elder and institutional support; malefics/Ji mean more friction in kinship or paperwork.
cnDesc: 父母宫（相貌宫）主与父母长辈的缘分、得长辈庇荫的程度，也兼看学历文书、遗传相貌与和上级的关系；主星吉化则易得长辈与制度助力，逢煞忌则亲缘或文书上多磨合。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数子女宫：子女缘分之外，还管创造力、学生和下属
enTitle: The Children Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Beyond Offspring—Creativity, Students and Subordinates
enDesc: The Children Palace governs bonds with children and by extension creativity, output and works, students/juniors and subordinates, plus some romance and partnership. Auspicious transformations mean capable juniors and rich creativity; malefics/Ji mean more worry over what you create or lead.
cnDesc: 子女宫主与子女的缘分和相处，也延伸看一个人的创造力、作品产出、学生晚辈与下属关系，以及部分桃花与合伙；主星吉化则晚辈得力、创作丰沛，逢煞忌则在这些「我所生、我所带」的事上多操心。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数为什么同生肖甚至同八字的人命运也不同
enTitle: Why People With the Same Zodiac Sign—or Even Similar Birth Data—Differ in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: The zodiac uses only birth year, while a Zi Wei chart needs year, month, day, hour, gender and location. Even with similar pillars, palace-star combinations, decade timing and personal choices differ; a chart gives a range of tendencies, not a single script.
cnDesc: 生肖只看生年一个维度，紫微盘却要年月日时、性别与地点共同排定；即便四柱相近，紫微命盘的宫位星曜组合、大限节奏和个人选择也不同，命盘给的是倾向区间，不是唯一剧本。
